module: "Vehicle > Cargo Containers" debug tool. Queries all active vehicles (core_vehicleBridge.requestValue 'getCargoContainers'), shows their cargo containers (volume, density, capacity, node cluster) and lets you send volume/density to them or fill them at an adjustable flow rate. Can be opened outside career.
notes: Fill rate: volume += flowRate * maxRate * dt (liters), clamped to [0, capacity].
Probable typo: container.currenDensity (instead of currentDensity) is read to initialize the density, which is therefore always 1 by default.
onInstabilityDetected is the same handler as onVehicleDestroyed.

debugOrder.desc: Sort order in the debug window (11).

vehCargoData.desc: List of vehicles with their containers, sorted by vehId: {vehId, name, containers, vehPos, clusterGeneration…}.

getData.desc: Asks each active vehicle for its list of containers and fills M.vehCargoData when all have replied (asynchronous). Returns an empty table if core_vehicleBridge is missing.

returns.desc: {} if core_vehicleBridge is missing, otherwise nothing.

updateVehicle.desc: Refreshes a vehicle's data: node cluster (if the generation changed), position of the vehicle and of each container. Returns false if the vehicle no longer exists.

returns.desc: false if the vehicle cannot be found.

drawVehicle.desc: Draws in ImGui the table of a vehicle and its containers with volume/density input fields and a checkbox to fill at the flow rate.

drawFlowRate.desc: Draws the Flow Rate (0..1) and Max Fill Rate (L/s) sliders, the 'Refueling' actionMap checkbox, and applies filling to the marked containers.

onChangeFlowRate.desc: Hook (e.g. input action) that sets the flow rate, clamped to [0, 1].

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the 'Cargo Container Debug' window: refresh button, flow rate, and for each vehicle updateVehicle then drawVehicle (removes those that no longer exist).

show.desc: Opens the tool outside career: hooks drawDebugMenu onto onUpdate (hookUpdate) and calls getData.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: removes the data of the reset vehicle and forces a new getData.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: removes the data of the destroyed vehicle.
